annotations.title: Crypto prices, all coins: Hyperliquid mid prices

description: Current mid prices of every Hyperliquid perpetual in one call (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE and about 200 more), as a coin-to-price map, or only the coins you name. Read live from Hyperliquid's public API. Use for a quick price snapshot of many coins at once, portfolio marks or a price ticker; for funding and open interest use hyperliquid_market. Example: coins=BTC,ETH,SOL. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

coins.description: Optional comma-separated symbols such as BTC,ETH,SOL (default: every perpetual)
